status: Conjectures supported by finite numerical tests; no all-count proof is claimed.
method: Independently refined marked elliptic roots with geometric Hodge branch checks and repeated-precision checks. The improved mixed double-edge solver uses bounded local correction, health-checked meshes, adaptive continuation, and preserved checked prefixes. Formula annotations are not imported by the workers and never enter root guesses. The three-loop solver uses stable combined Fourier exponents, conditioned matching matrices, graph-selected initialization and bounded branch continuation; routine correction targets18digits with an independently perturbed higher-precision repeat.
precision: Stored coordinates have more digits than the numerical error diagnostic. Decimal length is not a certified accuracy bound.

doubleEdgeAllDecorations.status: Conjectural all-count elliptic law, supported by finite computations; exact arithmetic for the proposed finite products is not a proof of the cusp law.

formula.law: w_i = x_i + i alpha_i/pi log(K_i sin(pi*t)/delta_i) + o(1)
formula.constantFormula: See REPORT.txt and formula-audit-utility.py: exact cap residue products.

notes: Full marked horizontal values are not reduced modulo one.
Fits leave the limiting real part, logarithmic slope, correction exponent and coefficients free.
The last computed point is recorded separately from the fitted limit. Slow fractional corrections remain visible at depth 28.
Fit-window ranges are sensitivity checks, not confidence intervals or certified error bounds.

tetrahedralAllDecorations.status: Conjectural all-count marked elliptic law; exact finite-product arithmetic is not a proof of the cusp law.

formula.capResidue: R_ab(M)=2M product over h in J(a,b),h!=M of (M+h)/(M-h)
formula.constantConvention: K_i is the positive square root of the product of two separate simple residues.

arithmeticChecks.reference: Independent Python Fraction evaluator; exact x, alpha, M, p, K and K squared compared against the browser module.
arithmeticChecks.note: Arithmetic coverage is distinct from high-precision conformal trace coverage.

notes: The claim fixes finite decoration counts and t in a compact open-edge interval; it is not uniform at vertices or in a joint large-count limit.
Opposite-edge totals determine proposed rational limits and slopes. The constants retain individual edge allocations.
The recorded periods are actual selected roots. No proposed rational center, exponent or constant enters a numerical initializer or replaces a point.
Generic root outputs use repeated precision. The symmetric count-two factor trace has full-TV checks only at five selected depths.
Free fit parameters and window sensitivity are numerical diagnostics, not certified accuracy bounds.
Shallow approaches are not counted as asymptotic evidence.
The former coarse count-two branch hop is quarantined and excluded from this evidence.

freeFit.model: y=beta*log(1/delta)+intercept+amplitude*delta^gamma; beta,intercept,amplitude,gamma all free; four consecutive depths

records.precisionNote: Separately selected marked Lamé-factor trace; two full-TV precisions at five selected depths, not at every point.

threeLoopMixedDecorations.status: Conjectural formulas checked against numerical data.
threeLoopMixedDecorations.purpose: Simulation and conjecture testing; research depths do not prescribe the precision or depth of normal plots.
threeLoopMixedDecorations.formula: w_i = P_i/(2M_i) + i/(pi M_i) log(K_i sin(pi t)/delta_i) + o(1)

conventions.normalizedPosition: t in (0,1), physical endpoint coordinate t/2
conventions.phase: Full marked P, without reduction modulo one or two in the horizontal limit.
conventions.constant: Absolute simple cap-product residue at M, computed with exact rational arithmetic.

summary.simulationRecommendation: Start with 5–10 decades and one displayed sample per decade. Increase depth only to inspect a later regime; large M slows asymptotic convergence.

threeLoopMixedDecorations.independence: Roots start from the marked graph and are continued numerically. The formula and its cap constant are evaluated afterward, not used as root initializers.
threeLoopMixedDecorations.precision: Very small finite-cutoff differences come from selected independent high-precision refinements; default plot precision has a much earlier arithmetic floor.

count32.note: A very small source epsilon is not by itself evidence that the leading asymptotic has settled.

trappedCase.precisionNote: Independent refinement checks the formula below the default solver arithmetic floor; these digits are not requested for the UI.

records.note: The former arithmetic failure is repaired; depth160 is a stress test, not a simulation default.
